openGangway.method: full-volume conservative component bounds from exact complete GLB ranges, plus 99 triangle-based support probes
openGangway.scope: static A-car connector only, no moving coupling or accessibility certification

lods.method: Conservative component AABBs plus barycentric support-height intersections on actual floor/bridge triangles, independently from GLB binary ranges
lods.limits: No door traversal, seated ingress, moving collision, platform binding, accessibility certification or front-salon free-walk validation
